test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Facinating'** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is Fascinating.
 
• **Fascinating** means **interesting or wonderful.**
 
 
• Example - ***It's fascinating that you can speak four languages***.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Imitation** is correct. It means **to copy or to act.**

 
 
• Example - *** That's Robert's imitation***. 
 
 
 
• **Effective** means **fruitful or productive**.
 
 
• Example - ***These methods are effective***.
 
 
 
• **Arrogance** means **boasting or immodesty**.
 
 
• Example - ***Kane shows arrogance in his voice***.
